name: agentmemory
summary: Persistent memory server for coding agents (Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, OpenCode and any MCP client) with hybrid search.
description: Install with `npx -y @agentmemory/agentmemory@latest`; the interactive setup wires chosen agents, an optional LLM provider (or keyless mode) and starts the memory server on the iii engine. Requires Node.js 20+. npm `@agentmemory/agentmemory` 0.9.30; GitHub release v0.9.30 (2026-10-06). Repo created 2026-02-25.
